Implementation commit: `6b1bee05a3fbb922415dc3774c63add2ad2a6b08`.
The package source manifest, tarball checksum, commands, logs and numerical
snapshots are in [validation/](https://github.com/Katsevich-Lab/sceptre/tree/abdb5c713b089c3b10dea93bd94955f0f20c0988/tools/components/schema3/validation). The earlier schema 2 evidence is
preserved separately; these checks were run on the final typed schema 3 code.

| Check | Newly executed result |

| `R CMD check --no-manual --no-build-vignettes` | **Status: OK**, including examples, installed-package tests and vignette R code. Manual PDF generation and rebuilding vignette outputs during check were not run. |

Environment: R 4.6.0, macOS arm64, ondisc 1.2.0. BiocCheck's warning is the
existing absence of Bioconductor infrastructure dependencies. Its six notes
concern console output, condition-message construction, nonlocal assignment in
the migration stage helper, function length, line width and indentation. These
are recorded rather than claimed fixed. An initial sandboxed BiocCheck attempt
could not acquire its metadata-cache lock; the completed run used authorized
cache/network access.

The seven deterministic workflows cover low/high MOI, NT/complement controls,
permutation/CRT, skew-normal/empirical tails, and union/Bonferroni/singleton
integration. Comparisons include actual calibration/power/discovery tables,
available numerical preparation payloads, compact response-fit payloads,
warnings and R RNG state. The reference is the archived installation of
`97d95da152dbf685e9f4664db7c302844cabe42e`; it was not rebuilt in this pass.
Its numerical code is unchanged. The reference driver restores the pre-calibration
QC budget for discovery/power to match the established corrected policy;
this does not claim equality to the legacy calibration-budget overwrite.
Intentional schema/lifecycle differences and absent empty table placeholders
are excluded. Raw candidate/reference observations and comparison scripts are
preserved. Native statistical sources have no changes.

Tests cover real physical schema 1 and 2 fixtures, historical results and unknown
provenance, canonical versus compiled pair ownership and multiplicity, stage and
result invalidation, failed reruns, compact fit validation/reuse, source/analysis
coordinates, backing save/reopen/relocation/wrong-file identity and response IDs
that differ from display labels. Current field tables are reflected directly
from S4 definitions; missing or stale field descriptions fail generation.

Active backing files are immutable during analysis; routine getters/reporting do
not monitor external mutations. Qualification is local to this Mac and the
recorded dependency versions. It establishes neither all historical-RDS
compatibility nor large-screen performance, hosted CI or Linux/Windows behavior.
Nextflow adaptation, push, PR publication, merge and release were not performed.
